name: Tiger Barb (Puntigrus tetrazona)
description: The canonical fin-nipper. Black-banded amber body; constantly chases tankmates when kept in groups smaller than 8 (Keenleyside 1955 — intra-school aggression suppresses heterospecific nipping above the group-size threshold). Avoid with long-finned tankmates (bettas, gouramis, angels). Explicit nipping block — scientific-name id wouldn't trigger the heuristic, so we declare it directly.
